title: Arrow Movement / single / 21011
description: Which path reaches the displayed final position and heading?
question: Use the 3 x 3 grid with x increasing right and y up. Read each command relative to the current heading. Move the stated distance and face the direction traveled. Stay inside the grid. Red marks the start and green marks the finish of one arrow. Which path reaches the displayed final position and heading?
